rows.grounds: temporal adverb indicating sequence after preceding rites
prescriptive action to be performed by the artisan
indicates conformity to the established manner

items.question: What actions must the chief artisan perform after the preceding rites are completed?
premises: The preceding rites and observations have been completed.
The chief artisan is the designated performer of this step.
The prescribed actions include striking and entering in the proper manner.
items.inference: Therefore, after the preceding rites, the chief artisan must strike and enter as prescribed.
uncertainties: The specific object or location to be struck and entered is not stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: Then the chief artisan should strike and enter as prescribed.
